tool_count_definition: 16 underlying tool invocations, dispatched through 9 functions.exec orchestration calls. Includes the notes-writing invocation.
design_decisions: Used Editorial calm for both pages because council officers need a municipal monitoring service and operators need a scan-friendly queue. Personal room would add a personal voice the organization does not have.
Replaced repeated sample cards with aligned rows. Mobile rows keep station, due time, status and update action visible.
Used system typography, shared page backgrounds, tabular figures, control boundaries and quiet separators. Status colors retain text labels.
The public hero leads with the concrete service, a sampling-plan request and a demonstration-address note. An inline diagram relates collection sites, sample and laboratory.
Kept the baseline behavior script, IDs and field names. Added status data attributes for styling and system-theme initialization. Controls remain disabled until scripts initialize.
Reduced the narrow hero title to 2.5rem after inspecting its 200% rendering, so complete words fit the viewport.
checks_run: Chromium 149.0.7827.55. Automated assertions passed for initial records, station search, status filter, empty result and reset.
Opened sample dialogs and checked station/due values, native form validity, required-status rejection, Cancel, Escape and return focus.
Saved a status, checked the visible record and focus, reloaded and verified local persistence. Cleared test storage afterward.
Checked theme toggle, system dark preference and explicit light override.
Checked no page overflow at 375px and 1280px, with normal and 200% root text, on both pages.
Inspected screenshots of queue wide/narrow, both dark pages and both 200% narrow pages. Rechecked the hero title with text ranges after adjusting its size.
Checked enlarged dialog width, required status validation and a visible keyboard focus outline.
Verified hero mailto destination and working methods anchor. Verified screen methods destination.
Reduced-motion emulation preserved visible content. No animation is used.
With JavaScript disabled, queue records remain readable, filter controls are disabled and the hero contact link remains available.
No page errors occurred during the main interaction matrix. Static check found no remote script, stylesheet or image dependencies.
known_limitations: Self-review in Chromium only. Safari, Firefox, assistive technology and forced-colors behavior were not tested.
Contrast was visually reviewed with the supplied semantic palette; no automated numeric contrast audit was run.
The baseline localStorage parser still assumes valid saved JSON. Malformed storage and storage-denied environments were not tested.
Inline diagram labels scale with the illustration rather than root text size. Its accessible description and caption carry the meaning.
Screenshots are local review artifacts. The final hero title adjustment was checked with text ranges after the earlier visual review.
